finalOutput:
Done. `chip8_zai-glm-5.3_01.html` is complete and verified — a single self-contained file (no external dependencies) that was validated by extracting the inline JS into Node with DOM stubs and running a 62-assertion test suite covering the full instruction set. All tests passed; temporary test files were removed.

**Emulator core**
- 4 KB memory, font set at 0x050, programs at 0x200; 16 registers V0–VF, 16-bit index register, PC, 16-level call stack, delay/sound timers ticked at 60 Hz (once per animation frame)
- All 35 opcodes: CLS/RET/SYS, JP, CALL, JP V0, SE/SNE (byte and register), LD/ADD immediate, the full 8XY0–8XYE arithmetic/logic group with correct VF carry/borrow flags (SUB/SUBN flags computed before the result overwrites the operand), shifts with shifted-out bit in VF, RND, DRW with XOR sprite drawing and VF collision, SKP/SKNP, and all F-ops (FX0A key wait without double-PC-advance, timers, ADD I, font, BCD, register save/load)
- Sound timer drives a square-wave beep via Web Audio

**Interface**
- 64×32 canvas scaled to 640×320 with pixelated rendering
- 16-key keypad shown as a 4×4 grid mapped to 1234/QWER/ASDF/ZXCV; press and release both reach the CPU, pressed keys highlight on screen
- Run / Pause / Step / Reset buttons, instructions-per-frame slider (1–200), demo-ROM button, and local ROM file loader — all wired and working
- Debugger panel: V0–VF, I, PC, current opcode with disassembly, DT/ST, and the stack contents, refreshed every frame

**Demo ROM** — hand-assembled byte array: draws a smiley sprite, self-paced by the delay timer (~30 fps), and moves with keys 2/4/6/8. Test suite confirmed it draws pixels, moves right when key 6 is held, and stays stationary with no key.

Two real bugs were found and fixed during verification: a VF flag ordering bug in SUB/SUBN, and three jump targets in the demo ROM that landed on instead of after the move instructions.

- 16-key keypad shown as a 4×4 grid mapped to 1234/QWER/ASDF/ZXCV; press and release both reach the CPU, pressed keys highlight on screen
- Run / Pause / Step / Reset buttons, instructions-per-frame slider (1–200), demo-ROM button, and local ROM file loader — all wired and working
- Debugger panel: V0–VF, I, PC, current opcode with disassembly, DT/ST, and the stack contents, refreshed every frame

**Demo ROM** — hand-assembled byte array: draws a smiley sprite, self-paced by the delay timer (~30 fps), and moves with keys 2/4/6/8. Test suite confirmed it draws pixels, moves right when key 6 is held, and stays stationary with no key.

Two real bugs were found and fixed during verification: a VF flag ordering bug in SUB/SUBN, and three jump targets in the demo ROM that landed on instead of after the move instructions.
